documents.title: Master services agreement
documents.text:
Master services agreement — Pellwood Holdings (fictional).
In this document "PHH" means Pellwood Holdings. Pellwood Holdings reports annual price escalator of 6.2% for FY2025. Pellwood Holdings reports uptime commitment of 91.05% for FY2025 on a adjusted (management definition) basis. Pellwood Holdings reports insurance cover of $23.1m on a reported basis. Pellwood Holdings reports maximum service credit of 18.7% for FY2025.
